idea-plugin.name: Structure Diff
idea-plugin.description:
Shows uncommitted changes at member level: added, modified and removed classes, methods and fields of each changed file, in a tree like the Structure tool window.

Language-agnostic: works for every language with a Structure view (Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, Kotlin, ...). The tree refreshes automatically when the VCS change list updates.

Toolbar

  • Refresh – recompute the tree now.
  • Show Nested Changes – show changes inside functions, components and object literals, not only inside classes.
  • Show Unversioned Files – include new files not yet added to VCS. Unversioned files directly in a content root (usually the repository root) are skipped.
  • Flash Changes – briefly highlight members and files that appeared, changed status or disappeared; removed nodes stay visible, struck out, until the highlight fades.
  • Follow Git Log – show the commits selected in the main Git log tab instead of the uncommitted changes, which are shown again while no commit is selected. The tool window title shows the selected commit.

Tree

  • A summary line below the toolbar shows the number of changed files, added (+), modified (~) and removed (−) members, and the total number of changed lines.
  • File nodes show the file name in its VCS status color, the same member counts (+ added, ~ modified, − removed) and changed line count, and the directory. A renamed or moved file shows its old name or path after ←. The tooltip lists lines added and removed and where the file was moved or renamed from.
  • Member nodes show the member in its status color; removed members are struck out. The tooltip shows the old and new signature when it changed, and the lines added and removed.
  • An added or removed member with children counts once; a modified container counts only through its changed children.
  • When changes span several VCS roots, files are grouped by root.

Navigation

  • Double-click or Enter – jump to the member in the source.
  • Middle-click – open the diff scrolled to that member.
  • Context menu: Show Diff, Jump to Source and Copy Path, with the IDE's shortcuts for Show Diff and Jump to Source.
